title: Cây trồng Sobi Garden: 5 cây × 4 giai đoạn
decisions: No Garden reference images exist yet; crop looks follow the plain farm crops named in content/garden/crops.json (grass, wheat, corn, potato, carrot) in the Sobi Farm style. The crop stands alone (no pot, no plot, no soil patch): GardenScene draws it on plot_soil, origin at the bottom. Root crops show their tops above ground only (a hint of orange / tan at the base when ripe).

cells.desc: Forage Grass sprout: three tiny fresh green grass blades
Forage Grass growing: a small leafy tuft of bright green grass blades
Forage Grass ripe: a thick lush round tuft of tall juicy green grass with a few soft seed tips, ready to cut for pigs
Forage Grass wilted: the tuft drooping and straw-yellow
Wheat sprout: a few thin upright green shoots
Wheat growing: a clump of tall green stalks with young green ears
Wheat ripe: a clump of golden stalks with five plump golden ears leaning slightly, warm honey colour
Wheat wilted: grey-brown stalks bent over, ears hanging down
Corn sprout: two broad green corn leaves
Corn growing: a young corn stalk with long arching leaves, no cobs yet
Corn ripe: a tall corn stalk with two cobs, husks peeled open showing plump golden kernels, a tuft of silk on each, small tassel on top
Corn wilted: a dry brown stalk with drooping leaves
Potato sprout: a small cluster of round dark-green potato leaves
Potato growing: a bushy low potato plant with round leaves
Potato ripe: a full bushy potato plant with a few small white-and-lilac flowers on top and three round tan potatoes peeking out at its base
Potato wilted: the bush yellowed and flopped over
Carrot sprout: a few tiny feathery carrot leaves
Carrot growing: a fluffy tuft of feathery carrot tops
Carrot ripe: two big fluffy feathery carrot tops with the round orange shoulders of two carrots showing at the base
Carrot wilted: the feathery tops limp and brown
